$ types show --help
Usage: types show [options]

Print the value of each option.

Options:
      --addr addr              A netip.Addr.                             env TYPES_SHOW_ADDR, key show.addr
      --enabled                A bool.                                   env TYPES_SHOW_ENABLED, key show.enabled
      --level int8             An int8.                                  env TYPES_SHOW_LEVEL, key show.level
      --limits string=int,...  A map of entries of the form key=value.   env TYPES_SHOW_LIMITS, key show.limits
      --log level              A slog.Level, such as debug or warn.      env TYPES_SHOW_LOG, key show.log
      --mirror url             A url.URL.                                env TYPES_SHOW_MIRROR, key show.mirror
      --mode filemode          An fs.FileMode in octal, such as 0640.    env TYPES_SHOW_MODE, key show.mode
      --name string            A string.                                 env TYPES_SHOW_NAME, key show.name
      --network ipnet          A net.IPNet in CIDR notation.             env TYPES_SHOW_NETWORK, key show.network
      --peer ipnet             A *net.IPNet in CIDR notation.            env TYPES_SHOW_PEER, key show.peer
      --port uint16            A uint16.                                 env TYPES_SHOW_PORT, key show.port
      --ports uint16,...       A slice of uint16.                        env TYPES_SHOW_PORTS, key show.ports
      --ratio float64          A float64.                                env TYPES_SHOW_RATIO, key show.ratio
      --since time             A time.Time in RFC 3339.                  env TYPES_SHOW_SINCE, key show.since
      --tags string,...        A slice of strings that commas separate.  env TYPES_SHOW_TAGS, key show.tags
      --timeout duration       A time.Duration, such as 1m30s.           env TYPES_SHOW_TIMEOUT, key show.timeout
      --upstream url           A *url.URL.                               env TYPES_SHOW_UPSTREAM, key show.upstream
      --workers int            A *int, nil until a source sets it.       env TYPES_SHOW_WORKERS, key show.workers
      --zone location          A *time.Location of the zone database.    env TYPES_SHOW_ZONE, key show.zone

Global options:
      --flag-debug  Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env TYPES_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help        Show the help.
[exit 0]

$ types show --name Ada --enabled --level -8 --port 8080 --ratio 0.25 --timeout 1m30s --since 2026-10-12T09:30:00Z --addr 10.0.0.1 --log warn --upstream https://api.example.com/v1 --mirror https://mirror.example.com --zone Europe/Amsterdam --network 10.0.0.0/8 --peer 192.168.0.0/16 --mode 0640 --workers 4 --tags a,b --ports 80,443 --limits cpu=2,mem=8 --limits disk=100
name     "Ada"
enabled  true
level    -8
port     8080
ratio    0.25
timeout  1m30s
since    2026-10-12T09:30:00Z
addr     10.0.0.1
log      WARN
upstream https://api.example.com/v1
mirror   "https://mirror.example.com"
zone     Europe/Amsterdam
network  10.0.0.0/8
peer     192.168.0.0/16
mode     -rw-r----- (0640)
workers  4
tags     ["a" "b"]
ports    [80 443]
limits   map[cpu:2 disk:100 mem:8]
[exit 0]

$ types show --port 70000
types: show: invalid --port "70000" from flag --port: value out of range
[exit 2]

$ types show --level 1.5
types: show: invalid --level "1.5" from flag --level: invalid syntax
[exit 2]

$ types show --enabled=maybe
types: show: invalid --enabled "maybe" from flag --enabled: invalid syntax
[exit 2]

$ types show --timeout 90
types: show: invalid --timeout "90" from flag --timeout: time: missing unit in duration "90"
[exit 2]

$ types show --since yesterday
types: show: invalid --since "yesterday" from flag --since: parsing time "yesterday" as "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00": cannot parse "yesterday" as "2006"
[exit 2]

$ types show --addr 10.0.0
types: show: invalid --addr "10.0.0" from flag --addr: ParseAddr("10.0.0"): IPv4 address too short
[exit 2]

$ types show --log loud
types: show: invalid --log "loud" from flag --log: slog: level string "loud": unknown name
[exit 2]

$ types show --upstream %zz
types: show: invalid --upstream "%zz" from flag --upstream: parse "%zz": invalid URL escape "%zz"
[exit 2]

$ types show --zone Mars/Base
types: show: invalid --zone "Mars/Base" from flag --zone: unknown time zone Mars/Base
[exit 2]

$ types show --network 10.0.0.0/33
types: show: invalid --network "10.0.0.0/33" from flag --network: invalid CIDR address: 10.0.0.0/33
[exit 2]

$ types show --mode 0999
types: show: invalid --mode "0999" from flag --mode: invalid syntax
[exit 2]

$ types show --limits cpu
types: show: invalid --limits "cpu" from flag --limits: want key=value
[exit 2]

$ types show >/dev/full
types: main: write the options: transcript: no space left on device
[exit 1]
